summary.intent: Run an overnight autonomous improvement session (10:35 PM to 8 AM) on the Cohezion codebase using teams of specialist agents to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs), capture journeys through QuadratureNexus/FLUME VAE to SurrealDB, close the Mycelium feedback loop, fix test failures, and build compound engineering analytics infrastructure.
summary.outcome: Delivered the E57 additive calibration fix to QuadratureNexus (converging consensus from 0.725→0.846 over 5 Mycelium cycles), built a 10-module compound analytics subsystem, fixed 100+ test failures across FLUME/compound/core suites, and added E55-E76 experiments to the overnight loop. Tests grew from ~6,797 to 7,142+ collected, with 1,865 compound/core/flume tests passing at session end.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment label at r['asi']['experiment'], status at r['status'], and primary metric at r['metric'] — not the top-level 'experiment', 'verdict', 'delta' keys that the retirement logic was reading
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically commits uncommitted changes to orphan branches and resets the working tree — workaround is 'git checkout HEAD -- <file>' to restore committed files
autoresearch.jsonl is tracked as a Git LFS file but the overnight loop writes real JSON content, causing pre-commit stash/restore to fail with 'File exists' — fix: git rm --cached + .gitignore
SCHEDULE labels in overnight_evo_loop.py must exactly match the experiment= string passed to log_result() for the retirement criterion to fire correctly
log_result() signature is positional: (run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment, **extra) — the 'run' and 'status' args were consistently omitted in new experiment code
FlumeVAE.forward() API changed from 4-value (recon, mu, log_var, z) to 3-value (logits, mu, log_var) then back to 4-value — downstream callers in evaluate_vae.py and train_vae.py drifted silently
OllamaEmbeddingProvider was removed from cohezion.flume.vae_encoder but test fixtures kept patching it, causing ERRORs at fixture setup time rather than FAILUREs
BioelectricNetwork uses percolation_analysis(threshold=) not percolate(), and the result has largest_cluster_size not giant_component_fraction
psutil mock in tests/compound/conftest.py must mock BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent=25.0 — CPU at 99.4% on a busy machine triggers the resource guardrail and blocks execute_task
vault_find_relevant_context is async; skill_selector.py was calling it without await in sync code — must use vault_search() sync wrapper instead
check_precipitation() on AxiomaticState returns np.bool_ from comparisons — must explicitly cast to bool for assertions

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback() used SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) — each cycle replaced the previous calibration with a smaller value, causing cycle 2 to decay. E57 fix: change to += accumulation via _mycelium_calibration, producing monotonic compounding toward the 0.85 HIHO threshold. Convergence formula: consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125 * (1 - lr/2)^n, max_error=0.00025.

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments[vt] = (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib on every call — this was erasing Mycelium adjustments. The fix: _mycelium_calibration holds stable cross-cycle gains, _score_adjustments is the per-deliberation read surface.

UCB1 beam search bug: UCB1 with trials=0 gives inf, so 20 untested transforms filled the beam before the confirmed-correct transform. Fix: track actual_best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1]) BEFORE UCB1 narrows the beam to beam_width.

FlumeVAE now supports dual-mode: legacy MLP mode via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256) for backward compat, and token-transformer mode via FlumeVAE(config=FlumeVAEConfig(...)). forward() always returns 4 values (recon, mu, log_var, z). reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode.
Was unpacking 4 values from model forward pass but forward() only returned 3 after refactor. Fixed to recon, mu, logvar, _z = self.model(data) after restoring z to return tuple.

Called self.mcp_client.vault_find_relevant_context() without await in sync code — unawaited coroutine RuntimeWarning. Fixed to use vault_search() synchronous wrapper which handles the async-in-sync pattern safely.

Added vault_delete(), vault_log_decision(), vault_find_relevant_context(), vault_edit() async methods. Added vault_write_sync(), vault_read_sync(), vault_delete_sync(), vault_search(), vault_search_by_operation() sync wrappers. vault_write_sync uses loop detection: asyncio.get_running_loop() — if no loop use asyncio.run(), if loop exists use loop.create_task().

Added autouse _mock_psutil_resources fixture patching both psutil.virtual_memory and psutil.cpu_percent=25.0. Must mock CPU too — at 99.4% real CPU, the resource guardrail in CompoundExecutor blocks execute_task() in the full suite.

Added HIHO_THRESHOLD=0.5 class constant, _logged_opportunity_hashes dedup set, generate_next_experiments(n, session_metrics, retired_labels) method. When coherence >= 0.5 returns exploit templates (parameter sweeps); when < 0.5 returns explore templates (new hypotheses). Retirement candidates appear in result 'replaces' field.

WarmCacheLoader was missing load_cache() proxy method — tests expected it as a delegation to self._persistence.load_cache() but only warm_client() existed. Also analyze_cache_effectiveness() was async with no real async I/O — removed async keyword to match test expectations.

Added check_precipitation() to AxiomaticState combining three physics theories: HIHO threshold (coherence > 0.5), Shannon entropy H = -p*log2(p)-(1-p)*log2(1-p) peaking at uncertainty boundary, and thermodynamic free energy F = E - TS. Returns dict with precipitates (bool), entropy, free_energy, and hiho_activated. Must cast np.bool_ comparisons to bool explicitly.

log_result() is 6 positional args: (run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment, **extra). New experiments E71-E76 were calling it with 4 args in wrong order — missing run (first arg from int(time.time()*1000)) and status ('keep' if delta > 0 else 'discard'). This caused all E71-E76 metrics to be recorded under wrong fields.

workflow: Surgical commit pattern: run 'uv run ruff format' + 'uv run ruff check --select=F,E9,E501 --fix' manually before staging; use 'git add <specific_files>' not 'git add -A'; KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 for Kaggle-touched files

When Entire.io checkpoint daemon is active, prefer creating new files over modifying large existing files — new files persist through checkpoint cycles while modifications to tracked files get reverted
TDD discipline pays off: RED→GREEN→commit cycle caught wrong mock targets (httpx.Client vs httpx.AsyncClient), wrong return value counts, and missing async wrappers before they became buried failures

For compound engineering metrics, the autoresearch.jsonl HIHO balance was 0.999 (near-perfect exploitation) — when schedule diversity entropy exceeds 0.9 with 3+ experiments, further exploration adds diminishing returns
Property-based tests (38 parametrized tests across 7 coherence values × 7 n values) caught the HIHO threshold boundary case and retirement label pass-through much faster than example-based tests

The V-model structural invariant test pattern (inspect.signature() at ~1ms each) is worth adding to any class with a stable public API — caught compound_score field removal and execute_task parameter renames instantly
When fixing test fixtures that patch removed symbols, prefer adapting to the existing non-patched code path (fallback_to_hash=True) over creating compatibility shims — fewer moving parts
Parallel agent teams work best when tasks are truly independent (test fixing vs experiment design vs harness validation) but need explicit status reporting via TaskUpdate to avoid duplicate work

The JEPA world model requires distributional diversity to learn — in heuristic deterministic mode it sees identical 12D states every run and initial_loss stays constant at ~1.0 regardless of replay buffer size

friction: Entire.io checkpoint daemon repeatedly reverted working tree changes to committed HEAD state — required git checkout HEAD -- <file> recovery multiple times per hour
autoresearch.jsonl LFS pointer/content mismatch blocked every commit attempt until the file was untracked and gitignored
pre-commit stash/restore phase fails when LFS files have content mismatches — no warning, just silently blocks commits with 'File exists' error
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var required for files near Kaggle directories, with no clear documentation on which files trigger it
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure mode (all evaluation prompts return empty strings) — detection relied on testing arithmetic ('2+2=') rather than the /models endpoint
ruff-format pre-commit hook auto-fixes staged files, then the stash/restore sees them as 'modified after staging', causing repeated commit failures requiring re-staging
System memory exhaustion (39Gi/39Gi swap used, 102Gi RAM) from background Node.js and next-server processes significantly slowed test runs but was external to the codebase
FlumeVAE had silent forward() return count drift (4→3→4 values) with no type annotations or structural tests to catch it — multiple downstream callers broke silently
The autoresearch loop's E51 experiment ran 4,786 times with no retirement criterion before it was added — discovered only after analyzing the JSONL stats
Compound module changes made in working tree were sometimes committed by agents to the wrong branch/commit, requiring careful reconciliation of who committed what
open_items: CLI train tests (test_flume_cli.py, test_cli_train.py) still fail with SIGSEGV from GPU/HIP kernel compilation — requires hardware-level fix or skip markers
28 swarm tests need a live Ollama service endpoint — need mock or skip condition for CI environments without GPU
JEPA world model learning flat in heuristic mode due to monoculture inputs — E46 showed constant initial_loss ~1.0; needs LLM mode with genuine score variance to produce meaningful learning signal
E71-E76 experiments added to schedule but not yet validated with real LLM voices (Lemonade in silent failure) — metrics are heuristic baselines only
Ouroboros fires 320+ false HIHO drift events on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions — needs a flag to distinguish research experiments from production deliberations
SurrealDB journey_point table shows 225,550 records but E55-E62 experiments used nexus.deliberate() directly (bypassing telemetry bus) — 41,983+ runs not persisted
ExperimentScheduler is not yet wired into the overnight_evo_loop main iteration loop for auto-retirement — currently requires manual monitoring via compound_analytics_cli.py
vault_log_decision and vault_log_experiment were saved to local file as fallback (vault offline) — need to verify persistence when vault server is available
The test_flume_paraphrases_closer_than_unrelated fix used deterministic category vectors — if real embedding model is restored, these vectors won't reflect actual semantic space
Kaggle worktree nemotron improvements (v5.1 2.3x metric improvement) are on autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502 branch as PR #113 — not yet merged to main
